summary:
Main
Iron ore futures traded firmer on Friday. The DCE most-traded I2701 contract settled at 727 yuan/mt, up1.04% from the previous session. Qingdao port spot prices rose by an average of 1 yuan/mt, with traders showing only moderate enthusiasm in offering and mills buying on an as-needed basis.
